title: ALICE Cycle-Consistent Spiral BiGAN
intuition: Joint BiGAN (G(z), E(x), D(x, z)) with ALICE cycle-consistency regularization on a 2D Archimedes spiral, requiring >= 15/16 arc bins, high sample quality, accurate x and z reconstructions, and arc consistency >= 0.90.
failure_mode: Without stable joint-distribution matching, encoder-generator pairs fold spiral turns onto one another, degrading latent_recon_rmse or arc_consistency.
protocol_notes: Tier-4 stretch benchmark (4,000 updates, MoGParticlePrior sigma=0.06).
